blocks.title: Verify locally with shared read-only cloud cache
blocks.code:
zig build && zig build test-opcodes
scripts/smthrs test //.smithers:test-factory
uphill --compact
node scripts/smithers-auth.mjs verify

cards.title: Reproduce first
cards.text: Include a minimal failing Zig, C, or TypeScript test with hardfork, bytecode, and expected gas or output.
cards.label: Step 1

cards.title: Run untrusted freely
cards.text: Run builds, tests, and Uphill locally or in PR CI using read-only cache hits from build.smithers.sh. Untrusted runs never write to the cache or skip gates.
cards.label: Step 2

cards.title: Clear Lighthouse backpressure
cards.text: Keep safety, TigerStyle, verification, docs, and factory scores green. Every crash must become a graceful error.
cards.label: Step 3

cards.title: Connect your agent via MCP
cards.text: Point Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Antigravity at https://smithers.sh/evmts/guillotine/mcp with one-time PKCE auth. Maintainers approve and merge.
cards.label: Step 4

blocks.title: Ask about Guillotine
blocks.placeholder: Ask about dispatch schedules, formal proofs, gas rules, or SDKs…

blocks.title: Guillotine
blocks.tagline: An ultra-fast, formally verified Ethereum Virtual Machine written in Zig 0.17.1 with register-passing tailcall dispatch.
blocks.text: Passes 66,652 / 66,652 official Ethereum Execution Spec Tests (Frontier through Osaka), 55 Zean Lean 4 proofs, 32 SMT theorems, and ships native Zig, C ABI, and Bun FFI TypeScript surfaces.

announcement.label: v0.1.0 Beta · 100% EEST + Zean direct Zig AIR to Lean 4.35 proofs

stats.label: Native package and C ABI surfaces

cards.title: Register-passing tailcall engine
cards.text: Preprocesses bytecode into 8-byte dispatch schedules with basic-block gas batching, synthetic opcode fusions, and stock Zig 0.17.1 preserve_none tailcalls.
cards.label: Dispatch

cards.title: Dual Zean and Lean 4 formal stack
cards.text: Direct Zig 0.17.1 AIR to Lean 4.35.0 proofs via Zean, hand-authored Lean specs, Bitwuzla and Z3 SMT bitvector proofs, and LLVM IR equivalence checks.
cards.label: Verification

cards.title: Frontier through Osaka and Base L2
cards.text: Complete mainnet hardfork coverage plus Base and OP Stack Bedrock through Jovian with EIP-7702 authorizations, L1 data fees, and deposits.
cards.label: Mainnet + L2

cards.title: TigerStyle zero-crash posture
cards.text: Every runtime error returns gracefully, O(1) undo-log snapshots protect state atomicity, and Uphill Lighthouse audits enforce continuous backpressure.
cards.label: Safety

cards.title: Fast native precompiles
cards.text: Pure-Zig secp256k1 ECRECOVER at 0.171 ms, adaptive Montgomery MODEXP, BN254 GLV, BLS12-381 via blst, KZG 4844, and SIMD calldata counting.
cards.label: Crypto

cards.title: Built in public on Smithers Cloud
cards.text: Public MCP server, shared build.smithers.sh object store with untrusted-read isolation, Engineering Wiki, Mythical History, and automated releases.
cards.label: Factory

cards.title: dep.module("evm")
cards.text: Embed the dispatch EVM, Layer 2 module, and Voltaire primitives directly in Zig 0.17.1 projects.
cards.label: Zig

cards.title: libguillotine_ffi
cards.text: Prebuilt macOS arm64 and Linux x86_64 shared libraries with guillotine.h and Custom SDK Builder recipes.
cards.label: C ABI

cards.title: @tevm/guillotine
cards.text: Zero-overhead Bun FFI SDK shipping both prebuilds with 340 passing E2E and fuzz tests.
cards.label: TypeScript

cards.title: ZEVM
cards.text: Embeddable Zig Ethereum node with JSON-RPC and beacon light client built in the Tevm ecosystem.
cards.label: Node

cards.title: Voltaire
cards.text: High-performance Zig and TypeScript Ethereum primitives and cryptography powering Guillotine.
cards.label: Primitives

cards.label: Reference
